name: Navaconcejo (Spain)
description: Divided diagonally from the lower hoist to the upper fly, green above and white below, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Navaconcejo (a castle between trees on white above a cross on green).
history: The arms and the flag were approved officially on 14 July 1988 (Diario Oficial de Extremadura no. 59 of 26 July 1988); the flag is described as square, divided per bend sinister green and white, charged at its centre with the municipal arms.

features.role: Navaconcejo arms — castle between trees above a cross
